name: Unconventional Gym
source:
Ryu enrolls in a gym in order to improve his body, but has no idea that the establishment comes with very particular forms of training, rewards and punishments.

Not to mention there is a police investigation into a potential drug ring, a vicious murderer is running around killing people, and there is a possible love triangle brewing. Will Ryu be able to survive and possibly find love?
